caption: The drawing consists of a tan or beige background with a grid-like texture, suggesting it was made on woven fabric or canvas. In the lower center, there are three distinct figures: on the left is a small, anthropomorphic animal dressed in blue and red, with green, black, and white facial features, and holding something blue in its hand. In the center sits a brownish, human-like figure with red patches on the body, depicted on green grass with a small tree or plant behind it, and holding a round red object. On the right is another anthropomorphic figure dressed in blue, white, and red, with a similar facial structure to the left figure, holding a small blue object in its left hand. To the right of these figures, there is a band of horizontal decorative pattern composed of a black mesh background with green and pink floral or leaf motifs. Above and around these main elements, there are faint outlines and unfinished sketches in a light color, including animals, plants, and landscape elements that are less distinct. The overall composition features detailed figures at the bottom with a larger area of the canvas filled with incomplete outlines and textured background above.
title: Petit Point
